prerequisites: Ability to collect data, present it clearly and concisely, and analyze results.
Ability to make predictions for different working conditions and estimate their reliability.
Ability to make decisions in an uncertain environment.
Contents of the first-year Statistics course of the Degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Design, develop and manage quality and integrated systems.
Apply basic and advanced quality tools.
Propose and implement actions that improve process quality.

syllabus_topics: Quality models. ISO 9001 quality management model. Quality audits. System certification. EFQM excellence model.
Statistical process control. Basic and advanced tools. Guidelines for improvement.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call (May), assessment consists of two exams (40%), individual and/or group assignments (50%), and active classroom participation (10%). For the extraordinary call, a theoretical-practical exam accounts for 60% and assignments for 40%. For the extraordinary advanced call, a single theoretical-practical exam accounts for 100% of the grade. In all cases, the final grade must be at least 5 out of 10 to pass the course.
